name: Ooiso Chihiro
source: For many years, she worked as [url=/c168009]Midosuji[/url]'s assistant, but branched out on her own a few years ago. Now a wildly successful and sought-after writer, she writes for multiple publishing houses at once. It seems almost unbelievable now that during her training days she was bad at talking to people, as she frequently appears on TV and online as a news commentator.
